## Vendor Profile (VP)

The buyer-recorded intake dossier for a would-be vendor: identity, tax ID and bank details (both rendered masked to last-4 in every read format), and dated compliance credentials — certifications with expiry dates plus an insurance expiry.

`complianceOk` is the award gate: current insurance AND no expired certification. The RFQ Comparison Board reads it to disable Award, and OnboardVendorCommand refuses a non-compliant profile. Single-persona rule: there is no vendor-facing submission flow — the procurement manager transcribes the vendor's paperwork.

### Desk-merge additions (additive)

The profile also carries the negotiated Payment Terms ("2/10 net 30", rendered by its own field + editor) and Lifecycle Dates (invited/activated/reviewed stamps) — both added additively in the Desk-spec merge; instances written before them deserialize unchanged.

### Examples

Acme Supply (onboarded, compliance current, linked to its active Vendor) and Norvik Ltd (approved but award-blocked — its ISO 9001 lapsed May 2026).

### Non-goals

No payment execution: the bank details exist so Finance can verify a vendor record by its last-4, not to pay anyone — payments belong to a Finance app. No vendor portal or self-service intake (single-persona). The active supplier relationship itself is the existing `Vendor` card (consume, don't rebuild); this card is only the vetting record that produces one.
